label: One resource type
subgoals: Count one iteration's uses of the resource, times its occupancy
Divide by the number of copies
Round up to get the bound from that resource

label: ResMII over all resources
subgoals: Compute the bound of every resource type
Identify the resource that attains it as the binding constraint

label: Memory ports as resources
subgoals: Count one iteration's reads and writes to each array
Divide by the ports of the memory holding it
Compare the memory bound with the arithmetic bounds
